purpose: Automated job application pipeline using the auto-job-applier skill: fetch job listings, draft cover letters, fill application forms, and log applications. Enables Nathan to apply to multiple positions with minimal manual effort.
model_policy: AI drafting for cover letters; template-first, human review before submit
startup: On-demand via skill invocation; no persistent agent
validation: PASS: skill directory exists with all required scripts and references
approval_gates: Nathan review before any application submission
rollback: Delete logged application from log_application output
kpi: Applications submitted / interview rate / offer rate
